items.q: How long does it take to get started?
items.a: A few minutes. Answer a few questions, set up services and prices, and import your clients from an existing spreadsheet.
No. Pay month to month and cancel anytime.
Yes. Every business's data is separated at the database level, every access is logged, and you can export or erase a client's data on request.

items.q: Do my clients need to download an app?
items.a: Not necessarily. The app also works in the phone's browser, with nothing to install.

items.q: Can the AI assistant do things without approval?
items.a: No. The assistant only answers and prepares actions. Every booking, cancellation or change waits for your approval.

items.q: Is it right for my business?
items.a: It is built for small and medium businesses: studios, barbers, clinics, garages and more. Tell us about yours and we will tailor the setup.

footer.tagline: Business management and an AI workforce for small businesses.

about.title: Building the system small businesses deserve
about.intro: Small businesses run their days between a phone calendar, spreadsheets, WhatsApp and a notebook. MyBiz brings it all into one place – and adds an AI workforce that does the busywork.

values.title: Truly simple
values.text: Every screen is built so that even non-"techy" people get it on day one.

values.title: You stay in control
values.text: The AI suggests and prepares; the decisions are yours. Nothing happens without approval.

values.title: Privacy first
values.text: Every business's data is separated and protected, and you decide who sees what.

values.title: Built for real markets
values.text: Hebrew and English, local currencies, holidays and taxes – from the ground up, not as a translation.

terms.title: Terms of use
body: Use of MyBiz is subject to these terms. The business owner is responsible for the information they enter about their clients and for obtaining consent as required by law.
The service is a monthly subscription and can be cancelled at any time. Launch prices are temporary.
AI features provide answers and suggestions only; any action is carried out only after the user approves it.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
body: We keep only the information needed to run the service. Every business's data is separated and protected at the database level.
The business owner can export or erase any client's data on request, and every support access is logged and requires the owner's approval.
Servers are located in the European Union (Frankfurt), whose data protection Israel and the EU mutually recognize.

accessibility.title: Accessibility statement
body: We work to make the site and the system accessible according to Israeli Standard 5568 and WCAG 2.2 level AA.
The site supports keyboard navigation, screen readers, text zoom and dark mode, and respects the reduced-motion setting.
Ran into a problem? Write to us through the contact page and we will fix it soon.

page.metaDescription: A step-by-step guide to setting up your business on MyBiz: branding, services, schedule, team, clients and the client app.
page.title: Your first day with MyBiz
page.subtitle: Six short steps, about 20 minutes, and your business is ready for clients. Each step has a link straight to the right screen.

tips: Upload a square logo (PNG or JPG).
Pick a main color — the client app and emails use it.
Check your business details, address and time zone.
We added starter services for your industry — rename or delete them.
Set the length, price and number of spots for each service.
Create plans: memberships, punch cards or single visits.
Classes: add a weekly session once and it repeats.
Appointments: set each staff member's working hours.
Mark holidays and closed days so nobody books them.
Invite by email; they choose their own password.
Pick a role: manager, front desk or staff — or build your own.
Staff see their own schedule and can check clients in.
Import from Excel or CSV in one go.
Share your join code or QR — clients join the app on their own.
Every client card keeps history, plans and notes.
Add a card for after the trial; nothing is charged today.
You can change modules any time in Settings → Modules.
